player_prompt.intro:
Bon bini na Lights Out! Bo tin un grid di {size}x{size} di lusnan.
Meta bo ta pa apaga Tur lusnan (representa pa '.')
Kuando bo presiona un lus, e ta kambia su mes i su bisiñanan adjacentenan (ariba/abou/robez/derechi).
Tipea [row col] pa presiona un lus (0-indexed, asina e rang valied ta 0-{max_index}).
Bo tin tei {max_turns} moveshin pa resolve e puzzle.
Leyenda: 'O' = lus na, '.' = lus apaga

board.current_state:
Estado aktual di grid (Movimiento {moves_made}, {moves_left} moveshin nan ta resta, {completion}% komplet):
{grid}

invalid_move.wrong_format: E akshon mester ta den e formato [row col] kaminda ròl i kolòn ta entero for di 0 te ku {max_index}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Koordiná mester ta entre 0 i {max_index}. Bo a drenta [{row},{col}].

outcome.win: Felicitacion! Bo a resolve e puzzle den {moves_used} moves!
